explication: EvalScope is a framework for evaluating language and multimodal models, stress-testing inference services, and inspecting results. The principal workflow starts with a benchmark or performance run, invokes a model or backend, scores or measures outputs, and presents reports. Separate branches support agent-loop evaluation and RAG evaluation. README claims establish several product-level links; sampled code confirms the performance pipeline, external-agent bridge, and service registration. Other implementation paths are included where the tree supports them, but their internal call relationships were not sampled.
